messages:
nora: FYI Nimbus reported an unexpectedly large SLA credit on their March invoice, asking why it's $12.6k instead of ~3k. Anyone seen this pattern?
billing-bot: SLA calculation completed for account nimbus-inc. SLA credit computed: $12,600. Detailed breakdown: https://billing.redwood.ai/credits/SLAC-2026-03-nimbus (auto-note)
priya: Whoa that's big. Do we have the raw SLA events and the credit calc?
marco: I pulled the SLA event stream. Looks like the outage window (2026-03-18T01:12Z to 2026-03-18T02:03Z) was accidentally duplicated when the replay job retried. Two identical outage events were ingested which doubled the downtime minutes.
eli: That would double the SLA credit unless the calculator dedupes by event id. Does it?
marco: The calculator dedupes by event id for availability but the dedicated-capacity SLA path uses a different aggregation pipeline that keyed on start_time only. Because the retry created a new event id with same start_time, it treated them as separate outages.
priya: Can you paste the affected invoice lines?
nora: snippet: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-114
Line: SLA_CREDIT_DEDICATED  Period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31  Amount: $12,600  Reason: outage 2026-03-18
```
priya: Expected amount ~ $3,150 (single outage ~13 minutes * rate). So we need to reverse the extra $9,450. Finance sign-off needed for > $5k credit reversal.
finance-approver: I can approve the reversal if engineering confirms root cause and a mitigation plan. Please include remediation ETA.
marco: Root cause: replay job retry produced duplicate outage event; aggregation pipeline lacked de-dupe on event fingerprints. Short-term mitigation: mark the duplicate event as voided and re-run credit calculation for the account. Long-term: add fingerprint dedupe to the aggregation and a replay-guard on the ingestion lambda.
ops-bot: Created ticket BLG-3344: "SLA duplicate events causing overstated credits" assigned to eng-billing.
billing-bot: To reverse over-credited SLA we need a credit adjustment CM-2026-0150 and a support ticket reference.
priya: Please generate the reversal CM for $9,450 and mark as pending-post. Also update INV-2026-114 and notify Nimbus.
finance-approver: Approved: reverse $9,450 and notify customer that we will re-run SLA calc and issue corrected invoice PDF. Please include a short apology and confirm it doesn't impact usage charges.
marco: I generated CM-2026-0150 for $9,450 (pending-post). Will re-run SLA pipeline after voiding duplicate event. Target: void event + re-run by 2026-03-22 09:00Z.
eli: Can we check if other dedicated customers had outages replayed in the same date range?
marco: Running query: SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as dup_events FROM sla_events WHERE start_time BETWEEN '2026-03-17' AND '2026-03-19' GROUP BY account_id HAVING dup_events>1; will post results in BLG-3344.
ops-bot: BLG-3344 updated with investigation notes and query link.
priya: Nimbus account rep please draft customer note: say we identified an ingestion replay bug, we've issued CM-2026-0150 for $9,450 to correct the duplicate credit, and we'll send an updated invoice within 24 hours. CC eng-billing. Keep it concise.
nora: Thanks. After the reversal posts, finance: confirm CM posts and we update the PDF before notifying.
billing-bot: CM-2026-0150 posted successfully. Invoice updated to INV-2026-114-v2. PDF: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-114-v2
finance-approver: Confirmed posting. Good catch. Please include post-mortem in BLG-3344 and schedule a short retro with eng-billing.
marco: Will add postmortem notes and schedule retro. Also pushing a small fix to aggregation to fingerprint events by (start_time, source_job_id, event_type). Deploy target 2026-03-26.
priya: Nicely handled. Closing loop with Nimbus now.
